{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Identify valid baseline biomarker values (exclude sentinel value -999.0)
valid_baseline = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'][severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute the mean of valid baseline biomarker values
mean_biomarker = valid_baseline.mean()

# Print the number of valid observations
len_valid = len(valid_baseline)

# Print the mean
mean_biomarker, len_valid"}
